user.title: Static Radio (unofficial)
user.description: Plays the live stations of [Static Radio]({static_url}) on your media players. This is an unofficial integration, not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by Static. It needs no account.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Static Radio is already set up.

schema_version.title: Static's schedule is in a newer format
schema_version.description: Static now publishes its schedule in format {found}, and this integration was written for format {expected}. Stations may keep working, but something may be shown or timed wrongly. Check for an update to this integration. The notice clears itself once the formats match.

init.title: Static Radio (unofficial)
init.description: Choose the speakers that can be tuned to Static, and the phone a show's Support link is sent to when someone asks for it.

data.announce: Say the station's name when tuning

data_description.speakers: Each speaker chosen gets a station selector.
data_description.notify_service: A phone with the Home Assistant app. Choose none to have the link read out and not sent.
data_description.announce: Spoken at the start of the stream while the episode is fetched. Left out when you tune by voice, because the assistant has just said it.

leads.title: Lead for each speaker
leads.description: How far ahead of the live moment each speaker's stream starts, in milliseconds, to cover the time the speaker takes to make sound. 1000 is a good start; raise it if a speaker is behind other listeners, lower it if it is ahead.

tune.name: Tune
tune.description: Tunes a speaker to a Static station, live. With no station and no step, it comes back to the station that speaker was last on.

entity_id.name: Speaker
entity_id.description: One of the speakers chosen on the Configure screen. Leave empty when only one is chosen.

station.name: Station
station.description: A station by Static's own name, such as News, Nature or Sleep.

step.name: Step
step.description: How many places to move along the dial: 1 for the next station, -1 for the one before. The dial does not wrap.
